boundary: Preselection uses archive T-1 and VCR PRESENCE only. Current VCR identities, site coordinates and shapes enter observational coverage AFTER preselection. Owner T-1 ship orders are checked against the target IDs, not used to select them. Missing/conflict explicitly ABSTAIN. Horwasp race12 is out of scope. No combat pair, side, capture outcome, seed or Host execution order is predicted. No production/client/CURRENT modifications.
research_next: Extend ordinary C5 parent-queue held-out selection to these frozen sites; treat selected site outcomes as open/factual and reserve new games for genuine independent acceptance. Do not reinterpret this census as queue prediction.

selection.selection_formula: every game with >=6 consecutive-Tminus1 VCR-bearing archive turns and >=20 turn span; sorted game-ID even quantiles; each game 20th and 85th percentiles
selection.selection_inputs: source_members archive turns + typed_vcrs existence only
